feed.title: NPR Programs: Morning Edition
feed.subtitle: Morning Edition takes listeners around the country and the world with multi-faceted stories and commentaries every weekday. Hosts Steve Inskeep, Leila Fadel, Michel Martin and A Martínez bring you the latest breaking news and features to prepare you for the day.

entry.title: Candidates make final appeals to voters ahead of Election Day
entry.summary: In the final days before Election Day, the closing messages are sharpening, the competitive races are coming into focus and candidates are doing everything they can to win votes.

entry.title: How campaigns are spending the last weekend before Election Day
entry.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep asks Jim Messina, campaign manager for the 2012 Obama re-election campaign, how campaigns will spend the final weekend before Election Day.

entry.title: Former FBI Director James Comey to appear in court
entry.summary: Former FBI director James Comey faces charges for a third time from the Trump Justice Department. Even conservative lawyers say this new case is weak and should be thrown out of court.

entry.title: Morning news brief
entry.summary: Candidates make their final push to voters, Alaska roiled by allegations that Democrats tried to prop up a spoiler candidate, U.S. could resume conflict in Iran after monthslong pause.

entry.title: 'Carrie' and other horror classics get TV treatment this spooky season
entry.summary: With Halloween around the corner, let's talk about some horror classics that have been adapted for TV this season.

entry.title: Patrick Stewart, 'Star Trek' and 'X-Men' star, dies at 86
entry.summary: Sir Patrick Stewart died Wednesday at 86. The actor was best known for playing kind, paternal leaders who united families of misfits in franchises like "Star Trek" and "X-Men."

entry.title: Vermont is home to two of ICE's surveillance facilities. Locals are pushing back
entry.summary: Much of the intelligence behind the Trump administration's mass deportation campaign flows through two federal buildings in a quiet suburb in Vermont.

entry.title: Florida sees spike in dengue fever cases
entry.summary: Florida is seeing a record number of dengue fever cases this year as the tropical disease thrives in warming climates.

entry.title: Court rules man should be resentenced after AI video of victim was shown in court
entry.summary: Can an AI-generated video of a victim that's played in criminal court influence someone's sentence? A case in Arizona prompted courts to dig in.

entry.title: Voters in Providence, Rhode Island, will decide whether city divests from Israel
entry.summary: In Providence, Rhode Island, voters will weigh in on a ballot measure requiring the city to divest from Israel.
